text: Okay, great. So, I ordered a couple of things, and I've got two questions. First off, I got this 1000-piece jigsaw puzzle, but I'm worried it might be too hard for my little kid. Is there any way I could change it to the easier one, the one with the fewest pieces? And second, I'm not totally sure about the address I put in for the order. Could you maybe check that for me? Maybe it's wrong. I live at 445 Maple Drive, Suite 394, Fort Worth, Texas, 76165.
